title: CIA-UAP-013, Report of Unusual Flying Object Sightings and Attendant Scientific Activity
what_is_it: A CIA Information Report documenting unusual flying object sightings reported by a sub-source in Budapest, Hungary, including a sketch of the objects' suspected formation and flight path.
interpretation_warnings: No OCR text could be extracted from this scanned image; all facts derive from metadata and the war.gov CSV description only.
The report relies on a single sub-source in Budapest; no corroborating sources are mentioned.
A more redacted version was previously public, meaning this release contains additional content, but the extent of new material is unclear without readable text.
Cold War-era intelligence reports from behind the Iron Curtain should be evaluated with awareness of the geopolitical context and potential for disinformation.

verifiable_claims.claim: Flying object sightings were reported by a Budapest-based sub-source to the CIA in 1956.
